title: Exploring the applications and carbon reduction of multi-technology-coupled membrane biofilm reactors for sustainable wastewater treatment: a review
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW01030B, Critical Review
Chang Mei, Meng Zhang, YuChao Chen, Kun Dong, RuiZe Sun, XueHong Zhang, HaiXiang Li
Membrane biofilm reactors are coupled with catalysts, electrochemistry, and anammox technology; their principles, applications, and carbon reduction efficiency are analyzed.
